resize_tensor_images: resize a batch of PyTorch image tensors to a specified output size with clamping and interpolation
publish_tensors_to_visdom: publish a batch of PyTorch image tensors to a Visdom environment with a caption and grid layout
save_tensor_images: save a batch of PyTorch image tensors to disk as an image file after resizing
publish_loss_curves: publish training loss curves over iterations to Visdom line plots for each loss key
publish_scatter_plot: publish a 2D or 3D scatter plot of tensor data clouds to Visdom with random marker colors
